title: Mammals
description: David Attenborough narrates a look into the lives of mammals and how they have adapted to their surroundings. The first episode features animals that thrive in the dark.

title: Mammals
description: A look at how mammals adapt to the changes humans have made to their environment.

title: Mammals
description: How air-breathing mammals have found remarkable ways to overcome the many challenges of a life in water, from freshwater jungle ponds to the dark depths of the open ocean.

title: Mammals
description: From ice-covered seas to snow-capped mountains, mammals have conquered the cold, living in the harshest places on earth thanks to their intelligence and adaptations.

title: James May's Big Trouble in Model Britain
description: Hornby director Simon Kohler assesses the decline of his beloved company, and master modeller Jim is given the biggest build of his modelling life.

title: James May's Big Trouble in Model Britain
description: Hornby number two Simon Kohler takes on two of his biggest rivals in a dramatic showdown, and the company hires its first female product designer.

title: James May's Man Lab
description: James May helps modern man reacquire vital skills that are in danger of being lost as he learns how to defuse an unexploded bomb, build a concrete kitchen and serenade a woman.

title: James May's Man Lab
description: James May helps modern man reacquire vital skills as he navigates the high seas the old-fashioned way, engages in a duel over a parking space, and builds a pub.

title: Abandoned Engineering
description: Claustrophobic prison cells that contain a story worthy of international acclaim, and a vast mountainside complex that held the power to change the world.

title: Attenborough's Natural Curiosities
description: Sir David Attenborough looks at nature's most amazing animals. He focuses on the zebra's stripes and the wings of the butterfly.

title: Adolf Hitler's War
description: The Red Army develops strength and Hitler's Spring Offensive is stopped at Stalingrad; and in the largest ghetto the inhabitants' fight back in the Warsaw Uprising.

title: Adolf Hitler's War
description: In Kursk, a 'battlefield' the size of Wales, the tide turns, and the Soviet's push back, but as Germany retreats, they destroy all evidence of their genocidal activities.

title: Adolf Hitler's War
description: Hitler's War moves to its endgame as the Soviets cross the German border - with a death toll of over 40 million, a new, scarred Europe will emerge.

title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
description: Charting the evolution of Auschwitz concentration camp and the mentality of its perpetrators. This episode looks at the camp's beginnings.
